name: quantum-entanglement
description: Use this skill when the user says 'entanglement', 'Bell state', 'EPR pair', 'CHSH', 'Bell inequality', 'quantum teleportation', 'superdense coding', 'GHZ state', 'no-communication theorem', 'entanglement entropy'. Explains entanglement precisely (non-separable states, Bell/CHSH violations, what it can and cannot do), builds Bell/GHZ states, and implements teleportation and CHSH tests in Qiskit with verification. Do NOT use for: single-qubit gate basics (quantum-computing/qubits-and-gates), QKD/network engineering, or QEC codes (quantum-computing/quantum-error-correction).
